SELECT  (count(*) AS ?var1)
WHERE
  { _:b0  url:description  "taxon"@sv }

PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  (COUNT(?var1) AS ?var2)
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P1542  wde:Q576349 }
